test_cases.description: Verify that when Config_CIP_Fault_Init is True after CIP completes, the LRU software repeats the CIP Configuration Discrete Test and then uses Config_LRU_PSR as the next configuration source within 100 ms.
test_cases.initial_condition: CIP has completed execution and Config_CIP_Fault_Init is set to True.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger CIP completion event; set Config_CIP_Fault_Init to True.
test_cases.expected_result: The CIP Configuration Discrete Test is repeated; after the repeat sequence, the configuration source switches to Config_LRU_PSR.
test_cases.pass_criteria: The repeat occurs and Config_LRU_PSR is used within 100 ms of CIP completion.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Measure elapsed time from CIP completion to switch to Config_LRU_PSR; ensure it does not exceed 100 ms.

test_cases.description: Boundary test for maximum allowed duration of CIP Configuration Discrete Test repeat sequence (100 ms).
test_cases.initial_condition: CIP has completed execution and Config_CIP_Fault_Init is True.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger CIP completion event; set Config_CIP_Fault_Init to True; simulate worst‑case delay in repeat sequence.
test_cases.expected_result: The total duration of the repeat sequence, including retries, should be exactly 100 ms.
test_cases.pass_criteria: The elapsed time from CIP completion to switch to Config_LRU_PSR is <= 100 ms and as close as possible to 100 ms.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Use a high‑resolution timer to capture start and end times; verify that duration is <= 100 ms.

test_cases.description: Robustness test to ensure no repeat occurs when Config_CIP_Fault_Init is False after CIP completes.
test_cases.initial_condition: CIP has completed execution and Config_CIP_Fault_Init is False.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger CIP completion event; set Config_CIP_Fault_Init to False.
test_cases.expected_result: No CIP Configuration Discrete Test repeat; configuration source remains unchanged.
test_cases.pass_criteria: No repeat sequence observed; Config_LRU_PSR is not used.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Monitor system for any repeat activity; confirm that configuration source remains as before.

test_cases.description: DC test to confirm that if CIP does not complete, the repeat sequence is not initiated even if Config_CIP_Fault_Init is True.
test_cases.initial_condition: CIP is still running; Config_CIP_Fault_Init is True.
test_cases.test_inputs: Set Config_CIP_Fault_Init to True while CIP is in progress.
test_cases.expected_result: No CIP Configuration Discrete Test repeat; system continues normal operation.
test_cases.pass_criteria: No repeat sequence observed; configuration source remains unchanged.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Verify that repeat is only triggered after CIP completion event.

test_cases.description: Verify that Config_CIP_Fault_Init is initialized to False at the start of CIP
test_cases.initial_condition: CIP not started; Config_CIP_Fault_Init uninitialized or in any state
test_cases.expected_result: Config_CIP_Fault_Init is set to False immediately after CIP start
test_cases.pass_criteria: Variable value equals False after CIP start event
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Observe the state of Config_CIP_Fault_Init before and after the CIP start event to confirm initialization to False.

test_cases.description: Verify that the LRU software correctly reads and debounces all configuration pins when they remain stable for longer than the required 10 ms period.
test_cases.initial_condition: All configuration pins (ID0_DSP to ID7_DSP) are set to a known stable state (e.g., all low) and the LRU system is in reset.
test_cases.test_inputs: Set all configuration pins to logic low for 15 ms.
test_cases.expected_result: Config_ID_Disc_Dbnce_Init is computed as 0x00 (all bits low).
test_cases.pass_criteria: The value of Config_ID_Disc_Dbnce_Init matches the expected 0x00 after the 10 ms debounce period.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Use a hardware test bench or simulation to hold the pins low for 15 ms and capture the computed Config_ID_Disc_Dbnce_Init value.

test_cases.description: Verify correct debouncing when configuration pins change state exactly at the 10 ms boundary.
test_cases.initial_condition: All configuration pins are initially low and the LRU system is in reset.
test_cases.test_inputs: Set all pins high for 5 ms, then set them low for the remaining 5 ms of a 10 ms window.
test_cases.expected_result: Config_ID_Disc_Dbnce_Init is computed as 0x00 (final stable state after debounce).
test_cases.pass_criteria: The computed Config_ID_Disc_Dbnce_Init equals 0x00, confirming that the debounce logic correctly ignores transient changes at the boundary.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Ensure precise timing of the 5 ms high and 5 ms low intervals using a timing controller or simulation.

test_cases.description: Verify that the debouncing logic correctly filters out rapid fluctuations within the 10 ms debounce period.
test_cases.initial_condition: All configuration pins are initially low and the LRU system is in reset.
test_cases.test_inputs: Toggle each configuration pin randomly every 1 ms for a total of 10 ms, ending with all pins high.
test_cases.expected_result: Config_ID_Disc_Dbnce_Init is computed as 0xFF (all bits high) after the debounce period.
test_cases.pass_criteria: The computed Config_ID_Disc_Dbnce_Init matches the expected 0xFF, indicating that transient fluctuations were successfully debounced.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Use a random number generator or scripted pattern to toggle pins at 1 ms intervals and verify the final computed value.

test_cases.description: Verify that Config_CIP_Fault_Init is set to TRUE when SurfaceID is SURFC_INVALID.
test_cases.pass_criteria: The software sets Config_CIP_Fault_Init to TRUE as specified.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Execute the computation routine and confirm the output flag matches the expected TRUE value.

test_cases.description: Verify that Config_CIP_Fault_Init is set to FALSE when SurfaceID is a valid identifier.
test_cases.initial_condition: SurfaceID is initialized to a valid identifier (e.g., SURFC_VALID).
test_cases.pass_criteria: The software sets Config_CIP_Fault_Init to FALSE as specified.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Execute the computation routine and confirm the output flag matches the expected FALSE value.

test_cases.description: Robustness test: Verify that Config_CIP_Fault_Init is set to FALSE for an unexpected SurfaceID value.
test_cases.initial_condition: SurfaceID is initialized to an unexpected value (e.g., 999).
test_cases.pass_criteria: The software sets Config_CIP_Fault_Init to FALSE for any SurfaceID not equal to SURFC_INVALID.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Execute the computation routine with the unexpected SurfaceID and confirm the output flag matches the expected FALSE value.
